_comment: SHARED PLAN REGISTRY — the single source of truth for which programs exist, which file holds each baseline, and which row-ID prefix each owns. Read by BOTH scripts/dispatch.mjs (the compiler) and .claude/hooks/canon-gate.ps1 (the gate). Neither may hardcode a plan path or a row prefix.
_why: CTRL-1, found by the G0 program-zero audit 2026-08-14. The compiler and the gate were two implementations of one rule and drifted the moment OPS-17 was added: the compiler learned G- rows, the gate kept grepping only P-, so every OPS-17 dispatch passed PLAN-ROW validation unvalidated. A design seam, not a typo. This file makes the rule data instead of code, and scripts/plan-registry-divergence.test.mjs fails when the two consumers disagree.
_addingAPlan: Add one entry here. Do NOT edit the compiler or the gate. Then run: node scripts/plan-registry-divergence.test.mjs
_rowPrefixMustBeUnique: Row-ID prefixes must never collide across plans — that is OPS-17 governing rule 2. The divergence test enforces uniqueness.
